text: Introduction and consideration of Bills for enactment of By-laws.

June 29, 2022 Confirmatory Bill: Toronto and East York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 659-2022. June 30, 2022 General Bill: Toronto and East York Community Council enacted By-laws 666-2022 to 780-2022. Confirmatory Bill: Toronto and East York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 781-2022.
